s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive alteration of mental status with immobility and rigidity
salient_findings: Rigidity of axial and appendicular muscles
Hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT
key_facts: Required feeding tube and urinary catheter
Hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT
Homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body on MRI

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive alteration of mental status with immobility and rigidity
salient_findings: Rigidity of axial and appendicular muscles
Hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT
key_facts: Required feeding tube and urinary catheter
Hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT
Homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body on MRI

shortlist.label: Glioblastoma multiforme
shortlist.why_kept: Hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT and homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body on MRI

shortlist.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rim enhancement and surrounding vasogenic edema on postcontrast T1 MRI

shortlist.label: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive alteration of mental status with immobility and rigidity

shortlist.label: Hashimoto encephalopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated CSF protein and normal CSF cell count

shortlist.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive symptoms and abnormal brain imaging

raw.rationale: The patient's rapid progression to a vegetative state, rigidity, and myoclonus-like signs (positive Babinski and Chaddock signs) are consistent with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, a prion disease characterized by rapidly progressive dementia and neurological decline.

rejected.label: Glioblastoma multiforme
rejected.why: Typically presents with more focal neurological deficits and mass effect on imaging, which is not the primary presentation here

rejected.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: Usually presents with more systemic symptoms and would likely have abnormal CSF cell count or protein levels indicative of an inflammatory process

rejected.label: Hashimoto encephalopathy
rejected.why: Typically associated with thyroid autoantibodies and a more fluctuating course, which is not described in the vignette

rejected.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
rejected.why: Usually occurs in immunocompromised patients and presents with multiple areas of white matter demyelination on MRI, not a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum
